question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled xAI realtime Talk gateway-relay provider with the intentional `ws` runtime dependency once current-head live proof is refreshed?
rationale: The remaining blockers are maintainer product/security acceptance of a new bundled provider and dependency graph change, not a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Require proof and approve the provider
options.body: Ask the contributor to refresh redacted current-head live proof, then approve the dependency change and merge if the provider semantics are acceptable.

options.title: Keep the provider external for now
options.body: Decline bundling this xAI realtime provider until the capability can live as an external plugin or a narrower provider API is agreed.

options.title: Pause for provider-policy design
options.body: Hold the PR while maintainers decide whether realtime voice provider additions need a broader provider catalog or session-resumption policy.

recommendation.title: Require proof and approve the provider
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to refresh redacted current-head live proof, then approve the dependency change and merge if the provider semantics are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily xAI/provider-boundary acceptance plus dependency approval, and recent xAI provider history points there.
